name: Jenny Holzer: Wrong Answers
description: Explore the thought-provoking work of renowned artist Jenny Holzer in this major exhibition at one of Porto's premier contemporary art museums.
longDescription:
Serralves Museum presents "Jenny Holzer: Wrong Answers," a significant exhibition dedicated to the influential American conceptual artist. Running from July 9 to November 1, 2026, this presentation delves into Holzer's extensive body of work, known for its critical engagement with power, violence, and communication. The exhibition will feature a range of her iconic text-based pieces, including LED installations, stone benches, and paintings, exploring how language shapes our understanding of contemporary issues.

Visitors to Serralves will encounter a contemplative and intellectually stimulating environment. The exhibition is designed to encourage reflection on the messages embedded within Holzer's art, which often challenges conventional narratives. The Serralves Museum, renowned for its modern architecture and expansive grounds, provides a grand and spacious setting for the display of these large-scale works. The content is primarily visual and textual, suitable for an adult audience interested in contemporary art and social commentary.

Admission to "Jenny Holzer: Wrong Answers" is ticketed. The Serralves Museum is located in the western part of Porto and can be reached by bus (lines 201, 203, 207, 502, 504) from various points in the city. Specific bus stops are located directly outside the museum entrance.
